en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a small Alpine town set in a valley surrounded by high mountains. The town features dense traditional European houses with red and gray roofs, a prominent church with a tall pointed steeple on the right, and another church-like building with a tower closer to the center. A chapel or small church stands on a hill to the left. The sky is overcast, and the whole scene has a hand‑tinted appearance. The word "Imst." is printed in the upper right margin, and a vertical credit line with German text runs along the left edge.
